row: Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth(DPU), Pimpri, Pune

Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth (DPU), Pimpri, Pune, a Deemed-to-be University, renowned since its establishment in 2003 under the UGC Act, 1956, has evolved into a distinguished educational institution with 15 Constituent Units. Recognized for excellence in Medicine, Dentistry, Physio, Nursing, Optometry, Biotechnology, Management, Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Design, Online Learning & more, DPU boasts state-of-the-art infrastructure and a committed faculty.

Accredited by NAAC with an 'A++' grade and granted Category-I University status by UGC, DPU upholds rigorous standards. Its achievements under NIRF 2025, ranking 4th in Dental, 12th in Medical, and 41st in the University categories nationally, affirm its academic prowess. Additionally, securing the 9th rank in the Swachh Campus Ranking 2019 underscores its commitment to cleanliness and sustainability.

DPU's journey epitomizes educational excellence and holistic development, shaping future leaders across diverse domains.
